title: Defense objects to Alcantara’s testimony in DPWH Mimaropa trial
summary: Lawyers for the accused DPWH-Mimaropa officials said Alcantara’s testimony only concerned his dealings with Co in Bulacan, which they said had no connection to the project in Naujan, Oriental Mindoro.
